products.name: Vellum
products.note: Personal AI assistant; on-device Mac app or cloud; cross-app memory; privacy-first design

reading.body:
Vellum is a personal AI assistant launched in 2024 that emphasizes privacy and persistent memory across applications, positioning itself against generic AI tools through user-configured personality and context.

The product's architecture reflects a deliberate choice about where computation occurs. Users can run Vellum on-device on Mac or in the cloud, a trade-off between local privacy and remote compute. The on-device option reduces data sent to external servers and keeps inference close to the user's machine. The cloud option presumably scales compute without constraining it to local hardware. This flexibility matters because personal assistants with cross-app memory and persistent context are computationally heavier than stateless chat interfaces. Vellum's pricing structure, which passes through model provider costs at no markup and charges $30 per month for access to larger compute, suggests the company is not hiding the cost of running inference. Customers pay directly for the models they use plus a fee for the platform.

The data does not cover Vellum's compute consumption, infrastructure partnerships, or whether the company operates its own servers or rents capacity. It does not explain why cross-app memory requires either on-device or cloud computation, or how much inference a typical user generates monthly. The categorization as an enterprise AI platform is notable but lacks detail on whether enterprise customers run Vellum differently than individuals, or whether the product is primarily sold to consumers despite this classification.

profile_text.body:
Vellum describes itself as a personal AI assistant designed to "know you deeply" and evolve alongside its user. The product runs either as an on-device Mac application or in the cloud, and emphasizes a privacy-first design with cross-app memory intended to reflect the way a user personally remembers information. Users can configure the assistant's personality and supply their own context, with the stated goal of making the assistant feel distinct from generic AI tools.

On pricing, the company states that new users receive free credits to start, that model provider costs are passed through at cost with no markup, and that paid plans begin at $30 per month, adding a larger machine, more storage, and bundled credits. The held facts record Vellum as founded in 2024 and categorize its product under enterprise AI platforms and agent orchestration. No litigation, MCP registrations, SEC filings, or patent records are present in the available data.
